assumptions: analysis_time_s is the video-linked time produced by time reconstruction
vertical movement acceleration is comparable after gravity alignment
enabled movement gaits come from the documented recording protocol; disabled gaits are never inferred
movement gaits are ordered by recording-internal signal-frequency clusters, not by physiological reference ranges
gait remains frequency-based; AngleZ is used only for recording-calibrated line direction, signed bending rate and direction-change candidates
positive AngleZ trend means left and negative trend means right for the confirmed test01 mounting; every new mounting requires validation
confidence is a technical signal-quality score, not a probability of a medical or biomechanical diagnosis
